rows.grounds: compound of digambarī, koṭi, and vṛtā; describes being surrounded by crores of sky-clad forms
compound of digambarī, gaṇa, and āvṛtā; describes being encompassed by groups of sky-clad attendants

items.question: What attendant multitudes encompass the sky-clad goddess in her sovereign form?
premises: The sky-clad goddess is surrounded by crores of sky-clad forms.
The sky-clad goddess is encompassed by groups of sky-clad attendants.
These epithets attribute vast retinues to the goddess.
items.inference: The goddess is characterized by being attended by innumerable sky-clad multitudes.
uncertainties: koṭi may indicate a literal ten million or a hyperbolic vast number.
items.plain_english: She is surrounded by crores of sky-clad goddesses and encompassed by hosts of sky-clad attendants.
